name: com.kidzdev.unity.audio
description: Production-grade BGM/SFX/Ambience audio service. UniTask async, AudioMixer-backed with dB conversion, cancellable crossfades, pooled sources, plug-in clip loader (Resources default, optional Addressables adapter), and plug-in volume store.

samples.description: Ready-to-run scene: BGM crossfade, SFX pool, 3D one-shot, loop SFX, ambience, volume sliders with persistence.
ISoundClipLoader backed by Unity Addressables — one handle per key, shared in-flight loads, explicit Release per load.
